doc.title: Ray Bauduc and Nappy Lamare Interview, 1959-09-09

title: Ray's favorite drummers and his trick-drumming phase
summary: Ray names Baby Dodds and Zutty Singleton and a trick drummer with Fate Marable's band as favorites. He was a trick drummer and tap dancer himself before settling on rhythm.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Who were your favorite drummers when you were a kid that you listened to?
Well, Baby Dots and Zootie Singleton. And there was another drummer that came down with... What's that name? Faith Marlowe's band that was on the... Oh, yeah.
You mentioned the other night you couldn't think of the name.

I can't think of his name. He played wonderful drums. No. He did a lot of trick stuff with drums. There were sticks and stuff. Of course, at that time, I was sort of a trick dumber. And a tangle foot dancer and everything else. Yeah. But I finally found out that I got down to the basic part of drums and got the rhythm end of it worked out. That's what I tried to do anyway.
